summary: This configuration tells search engine crawlers not to index or follow links on pages in this directory. It does this by adding a special HTTP header that search engines check before deciding whether to catalog your content.

explanations.3: IfModule checks if the mod_headers Apache module is loaded; if it isn't available, the code inside is skipped so you don't get an error.
explanations.4: Header set adds an HTTP response header named X-Robots-Tag with the value "noindex, nofollow", which instructs search engines not to index this page and not to follow any links on it.
